capabilities: Generate a summary note for a directory via a command
Turn file names in the summary into backlinks
Include a chosen file property next to each file name
Render checkboxes driven by a property value matched with a regex
Exclude specified files or directories and set search depth
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to auto-generate an overview note that indexes a directory's contents with links and metadata.
summary: Directory summarizer that creates a note listing a folder's files as backlinks with configurable properties, checkboxes, and exclusions.
